EmailTemplate.description: QCC: Arrival Airport compliment request email template will be sent 2pm the following day when the request was raised.CRM-8664
EmailTemplate.name: QCC_Arrival_Airport_Letter_2C
EmailTemplate.subject: Qantas Customer Care - {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Ref No: {!Case.CaseNumber}
Dear {!Case.Contact}
Thank you so much for taking the time to contact us about your recent flight. Your kind words about your arrival are very much appreciated.
We want to make your trip as smooth as possible, so it was great to read that your journey ended so well. The team work hard to ensure a seamless experience and will be delighted to read your feedback, so we’ve sent a copy of your comments through to our Airport Management to pass on to the staff there.
We are grateful for your ongoing support and look forward to welcoming you aboard again soon.
Kind regards
Qantas Customer Care
Note: This email was sent from a notification only address that cannot accept incoming email. Please do not reply to this message.
